Technical visual specification · v2

Taki Design System

Reference viewport: 412 × 915 dp · Android / Compose migration

A private music collection presented with the polish of a premium streaming app, without the noise of one.

4. Shapes, icons, targets

Radii

4 dp · 8 dp artwork · 12 dp cards/hero artwork · 20 dp feature panels

Icons

18 dp secondary · 24 dp standard · 32 dp transport

Touch

48 × 48 dp minimum for every tappable control.

Primary Play

64 × 64 dp button · 32 dp icon · ivory fill · dark icon.

5. Canonical screen geometry

Home · 412 dp

  • 16 dp screen gutter → 380 dp content.
  • Featured mix: 380 × 156 dp, radius 20.
  • Featured artwork: 124 × 124 dp.
  • Recently Played art: 104 × 104 dp, 12 dp item gap.
  • Two-column cards: 184 × 96 dp, 12 dp gap.
  • Liked Albums artwork: 140 × 140 dp.

Library · 412 dp

  • 16 dp screen gutter.
  • Optional summary: 380 × 72 dp.
  • Primary cards: 184 × 80 dp, two columns.
  • Browse rows: 56 dp high, transparent.
  • Quiet dividers; no giant browse pills.

Now Playing

  • 24 dp preferred horizontal gutter.
  • Hero artwork: 364 dp preferred; 280–380 dp bounds.
  • Artwork radius: 12 dp.
  • 24 dp art → metadata gap.
  • 3 dp progress track; 10 dp thumb.
  • 64 dp primary Play; 48 dp secondary targets.

Persistent chrome

  • Mini-player: 64 dp high, 12 dp radius, 48 dp art.
  • Bottom nav: 72 dp + system inset.
  • Nav icon: 24 dp.
  • Selected indicator ≈ 48 × 32 dp.
  • No bright-green nav pill.

6. Surface discipline

LayerTokenMeaning
0#090B09Canvas
1#111410Persistent low-emphasis grouping/navigation
2#171A16Interactive card/panel/mini-player
3#1D211BPressed or temporary elevation

Default elevation is 0 dp. Use tonal separation before shadow. The existing 3 dp raised token is an exception, not a default.

7. Motion

InteractionDuration
Press / selection120 ms
State / icon crossfade180 ms
Content insertion/removal180–240 ms
Navigation240 ms
Mini-player ↔ Now Playing280–320 ms

No bounce. No decorative loops. No animation may delay playback response.

9. Visual QA

  • 360 × 800 dp and 412 × 915 dp.
  • Font scale 1.0× and 1.30×.
  • Long title, long artist, missing artwork, loading and empty states.
  • Physical Pixel 7 validation.
  • No unexplained raw dp/sp/hex.
  • Artwork stronger than chrome; one obvious primary action.
  • Green remains semantic and restrained.

10. Source of truth

The Markdown file TAKI_DESIGN_SYSTEM_V2.md contains the full normative specification. This HTML is the visual companion. If the mockup and specification disagree, the written technical specification wins.
